definition: hair tied back so it hangs like a tail
description: A young woman in a cropped brown hoodie and matching sweatpants stands at the wooden barre of a mirrored dance studio, her long hair tied back in a ponytail that swings as she moves. She holds the barre and laughs, turns to face the mirrored wall, then drops to the floor into a low crouch with one leg extended, springs up into a jump with her knees tucked, spins with her back to the mirror, and finishes facing the camera out of breath and smiling.
